title: Parlay maker: research done, running on paper
body: Done and live on the engine (paper only, as you asked): (1) a bug that would have locked the maker about every 10 fills is fixed; (2) Novig pays other makers 4x more margin on tennis (+1.3 pts) than on the NBA (+0.3), so one margin fits no league; the engine now asks Novig what other makers charge (~0.6 a second) and learns each league's price; (3) same-game parlays now use a correlation model measured on 21,000 games; (4) a free workflow publishes the market table every 6 h. Write-up: research/novig_parlay_maker_2026-11-19.md. Going live is still your call and needs money in the wallet.
